name: mono
character: One channel, rendered and not folded: every track at the level the mix gave it, with no pan, no width and no head filter, so nothing cancels. For a phone speaker, a radio, a public-address system or a club system that sums.
label: mono master (rendered)
sources: Rendered mono: the mix is summed without placement (scripts/spatial_engine/render.py MonoBus). The alternative, adding the two channels of the stereo master, is what the mix.band_fold and fold.mono rows measure

compensate_max_db 3.0: two channels with nothing in common average 3.01 dB below either one (10 log10 2), so 3 dB is the most that averaging alone can cost a stereo part; a part that loses more than that is cancelling, and is not boosted

Loudness is set on the programme as two identical channels (how a one-channel file plays on a stereo system); measured as a single channel per ITU-R BS.1770 it reads 3 LU lower. The -1.5 dBTP ceiling is this project's two-channel policy
fold_band_max_db 3.5 is the same starting value as the mix.band_fold row
